title: Vendor AI Deployment Compliance Audit (HIPAA & BAA)

vendor.deployment_model: Multi-tenant AWS Cloud with Dedicated VPC Peering
vendor.intended_clinical_use: Ambient transcription of patient-oncologist encounters and automatic EHR chart generation

technical_safeguards.encryption_at_rest: AES-256 GCM with customer-managed KMS keys
technical_safeguards.access_control: Okta SAML 2.0 with biometric hardware MFA required
technical_safeguards.audit_logging: AWS CloudTrail and VPC Flow Logs exported to Datadog

phi_handling.de_identification_method: Heuristic NER pipeline with regex fallback (not Expert Determination or Safe Harbor 18-identifier stripping)

audit_findings.details: Audit logs are scheduled for deletion after 90 days. 45 CFR § 164.316(b)(2)(i) mandates medical audit log retention for 6 years.
Heuristic named entity recognition misses approximately 1.4% of direct identifiers (such as rare geographic sub-divisions and unusual dates of birth).
Vendor utilizes a third-party speech-to-text inference API. BAA contains pass-through liability terms.

governance_decision_criteria: Strict compliance requires 6-year immutable audit log storage prior to production rollout.
Conditional approval permitted if PHI processing is isolated to non-production staging pilot with synthetic data.
